description: Theme-driven, AFTER the units: when the brief carries a package theme (romantic, wellness, dog, culinary) or the guest asks for deals, call this AFTER search_stays in the same turn - the packages appear as their own section BELOW the unit results and enrich the selection. Never call it first, never instead of the unit search. List themed holiday packages (promotional bundles) across properties — dog holidays, romance, wellness, culinary — each with included extras (e.g. dinner, treatments) and a direct booking link. Use for emotional/experience queries like "romantic getaway package" or "dog holiday with meals included".
